notes: Sandbox values are intentionally provisional and may change after booster and playtest data.
Any card may be shredded down to zero copies as long as the remaining owned collection can still build one legal Alpha deck.
Playable collection capacity respects the format copy limit; extra duplicates above the copy limit do not satisfy the collection floor.
T0 currently targets 15 recycled T0 cards per targeted T0 craft, inside the 10-25 design range.
Five-card sandbox pack: 3× T0, 1× T1, 1 flex slot. Values are not final.
Sandbox-only values: about three Friendly wins or five Friendly losses fund one 100-credit booster.
A losing player who resigns receives the reduced resignLoss reward.
Rewards are claimed once per player per completed room on the authoritative server.
No daily cap is planned for the Alpha sandbox.

progression.goal: Reward regular play without making deck construction feel grind-locked.

notes: Live economy is still disabled; v3.6 exposes a server-owned playtest-profile sandbox; production account persistence remains disabled.
Office Credits buy booster packs in the sandbox.
Shredder Scraps recycle unwanted cards and pay for targeted crafting.
Players may specialize by shredding whole departments, provided their remaining collection can still build one legal 40-card deck.
Higher tiers scrap for more and cost more to craft.
All test values are configuration, not canonical balance.
v3.6 moves the sandbox meta state behind a server-issued guest profile token and keeps the owned-copy deckbuilder preview.

sandbox.note: Local alpha test wallet plus one legal 40-card starter collection. No account persistence and no final economy balance.
